items.briefing:
Australia's communications regulator ACMA has taken Optus to Federal Court over a Triple Zero outage in September 2025, a reminder that telco failures can have serious real-world consequences for safety. Separately, investment platform Sharesight is warning users not to rely on AI tools to calculate their taxes, after concerns about inaccurate results — a timely caution for anyone using AI for financial or compliance tasks at work. Security training provider KnowBe4 has also launched voice call (vishing) simulations, highlighting that phone-based scams remain a growing threat to organisations.

**Practical tip:** Never rely solely on AI-generated advice for tax, legal, or compliance matters — always have a qualified professional review the output before acting on it.

featured.title: ACMA takes Optus to Federal Court over September 2025 Triple Zero outage
featured.quote: ACMA takes Optus to Federal Court over critical infrastructure outage affecting emergency services.
